fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Jharkhand Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (JCECEB) has released the answer key for the B.Ed/M.Ed/B.P.Ed. Combined Entrance Competitive Examination (CECE) Admission on the official website of the JCECEB recently For the two-year B.Ed. course (Academic Session 2026-28. Applications for the JCECEB B.Ed/M.Ed/B.P.Ed Admission Online Form 2026 were accepted from 25 February 2026, to 25 March 2026. The written examination was held on 31 May 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their JCECEB Jharkhand B.Ed Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.

Jharkhand Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (JCECEB)

JCECEB Jharkhand B.Ed Answer Key 2026

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 25 February 2026
  • Last Date : 25 March 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 25 March 2026
  • Correction Window: 26-27 March 2026
  • Exam Date : 31 May 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 27 May 2026
  • Answer Key Available : 04 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General : Rs. 1000/-
  • BC-I, BC-II, EWS : Rs. 750/-
  • SC, ST,, All Female : Rs. 500/-
  • PH Candidate : Rs 00/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

  • Maximum Age : N/A
  • Age Relaxation as per JCECEB Admission Rules.

JCECEB Jharkhand B.Ed Admission 2026 : Qualification 

  • Candidates must have secured at least 50% marks (45% for SC/ST/OBC/PwD and other reserved categories) in their Bachelor’s and/or Master’s Degree in Science, Social Science, Humanities, or Commerce, or 55% marks (50% for reserved categories) in Bachelor’s in Engineering/Technology with specialization in Science and Mathematics. For M.Ed., a B.Ed. degree is mandatory. Candidates must choose one teaching subject studied in their qualifying degree with at least 50% marks out of 200 marks. There is no restriction on passing year, and final year students are also eligible, subject to fulfilling the required percentage at the time of admission.
  • For more details must read the official notification.

How To Download JCECEB Jharkhand B.Ed Admission Answer Key 2026

  • In order to download their JCECEB Jharkhand B.Ed Answer Key candidates are required to go to the important link section provided below.
  • After getting the link candidates need to click it for downloading their JCECEB Jharkhand B.Ed Answer Key.
  • Candidates need to provide their following details-:
  • Registration No. /Roll No.
  • DOB/Password
  • Captcha Code(if specified)
  • After providing their details appropriately candidates will be able to check their JCECEB Jharkhand B.Ed Answer Key.
  • Candidates can also check their JCECEB Jharkhand B.Ed Answer Key from official site of the Jharkhand JCECEB.

JCECEB Jharkhand B.Ed Admission Form 2026 : Mode of Selection

  • Online Examination
